name: ai-usage-analyzer
description: Analyzes how you use Claude -- local Desktop/Cowork data plus an optional claude.ai export -- into a live dashboard that opens with a ranked list of fixes: which chats belong in which Projects, stale vs. active work, model and effort fit, when you hit plan limits, stale memory, standing folder/host access, and enabled-but-unused connectors, skills and plugins. Read-only; never moves, renames, or deletes anything. Claude Code CLI sessions are excluded.
